text.p: Here are the main headlines from the afternoon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Latvia registered the highest number of unemployed in the Baltic countries, 95,300, at the end of June and had the highest rate of unemployment at 7.6 percent.
- Lithuania had a 5.3 percent rate of unemployment, with 93,300 registered as jobless. Estonia had a 2.2 percent rate of unemployment with 32,300 out of work.
